title: Inside Information
description:
Hyunsu gets in touch after a long silence. Voice buzzing with excitement.
"Bro, this one is real. Inside info.
This coin's listing catalyst drops next week. I pulled my jeonse deposit.
Get in now — let's change our lives together."

{name}'s account balance surfaces in the mind. And beyond it — the impossible distance to ₩3 billion.

choices.text: Trust Hyunsu. Bet what's on hand.  (jackpot or bust)
choices.result_text: The die is cast. {name} put the account on the line on Hyunsu's 'inside info.'

{name} said no. Hyunsu called it cowardice and hung up.
For days after, kept secretly checking the coin's price. It stung every time it went up.
Whether {name} dodged a loss or missed a gain — FOMO lingered.

choices.text: Try to stop Hyunsu. "That's dangerous."  (friendship / conflict)

title: A Hand That Holds Back
description:
"Hyunsu, you pulled your jeonse deposit? That's not right."
{name} means every word. Hyunsu's face hardens.
"You're always like this. You can't see an opportunity when it's right there.
Don't come crying when I'm in Gangnam."

Between friendship and money — what more is there to say?

choices.text: Keep trying to get through to him. Until the end.  (friendship / time + emotional cost)
choices.result_text:
{name} stayed on the phone until dawn trying to talk him down.
Hyunsu ended up reducing the amount. Couldn't stop him entirely — but not a total loss.
Real friends warn even when it earns them resentment — that was the only thing {name} could give.

choices.text: Let it go. His money, his call.  (peace of mind / guilt)
choices.result_text:
"It's your money, do what you want." {name} backed off.
Easier not to fight about it.
But when word came back about Hyunsu a few weeks later — that ease turned into regret.

title: The Holiday
description:
Lunar New Year is coming. Go home, or stay?
At the family gathering, questions will be waiting like a firing squad.
"Found a job yet? At your age. The neighbor's kid just bought a Gangnam apartment."

Dad said "don't bother coming if you're busy."
That one sentence sat heavier than all the questions.

choices.text: Go. Family is family.  (relationships / money + stress)
Don't go. Too busy.  (avoidance / guilt + relationship)
choices.result_text:
{name} made up an excuse. No comparisons to endure. No fare to spend.
In return — spent the whole holiday alone in a half-tatami goshiwon.
Dad sent a message: 'Make sure you eat.' For a long time, {name} couldn't reply.

{name} skipped the family gathering and saw Dad alone.
One bowl of gukbap together. No comparisons, no lectures.
Spent the fare — but saw the only person who actually mattered. Quietly.

title: The Gathering
description:
As expected. Questions rain across the table.
"Still like this? You need to lower your standards."
"My kid got promoted to assistant manager this year."

Dad quietly pours soda into {name}'s glass.
That hand was warmer than anything said all day.

choices.text: Smile and deflect.  (keep the peace / swallow it down)
choices.result_text:
{name} kept a straight face and smiled. "I'm working at it."
Atmosphere held. Dad wasn't embarrassed.
But on the KTX back to Seoul, all the swallowed words pressed down on the chest.

choices.text: "My life is mine to handle." Push back.  (relieving / atmosphere)
choices.result_text:
{name} reached the limit and didn't hold back. The table went quiet.
Relatives looked awkward. Dad's face tensed up.
Felt better — but on the way home, Dad's hardened expression stayed.
